summary: This PR closes four audit-confirmed phase_5 browser-execution gaps by adding four new, isolated modules (npu-engine.ts, builtin-ai-engine.ts, cross-tier-storage.ts, sync-engine.ts) plus additive shouldAttemptNpu/shouldAttemptBuiltinAi gates in tier-orchestrator.ts, all following the existing house style in this directory (env/factory injection for testability, honest typed not-selected/ready results, no fabricated capabilities). The code is well-reasoned: npu-engine.ts and builtin-ai-engine.ts correctly gate real inference calls behind tier-orchestrator's single source of truth for tier selection rather than duplicating detection logic; cross-tier-storage.ts wraps OPFS and Cache API as new backends while correctly reusing (not reimplementing) model-cache.ts's IndexedDbModelCache, with a sound priority-ordered fallback chain; sync-engine.ts's coalesceQueuedChanges() offline-conflict-merge logic was traced through all five documented cases (create+update, update+update, anything+delete, delete+create/update, create+delete) and is correct, and resolveConflict()/syncQueue()/pullDeltaSync()/SyncMutex are all sound, non-destructive (never silently drop a change) implementations. I independently re-ran `bun test src/lib/browser-execution` (108 pass/0 fail, not just trusting the self-report), `tsc --noEmit` (clean), and `check-guardrail-presence.mjs` (88/88 markers pass). The diff touches no schema/migration/auth/RLS/payment/security paths and no .github/workflows files, is purely additive (new files + additive gate functions + governance bookkeeping in ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml and ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml + a PROGRESS.md docs rewrite), matching tier1's low-blast-radius definition.
